confirmed_defects.status: CONFIRMED: fresh /var/tmp repro; real (non-dry-run) deletion of a target that has no receipt at all
confirmed_defects.title: Engine record parsed by blind field-drop: a TAB inside the target name forges a receipt
confirmed_defects.mechanism: run_verify strips the leading 'VERDICT' and two TAB-delimited fields without anchoring on the echoed path. souji-verify echoes the raw argument in its path field, so a target named 'fresh<TAB>SAFE<TAB>stale<TAB>no-receipt.txt' produces 'VERDICT<TAB><path-part1><TAB>SAFE<TAB>stale<TAB><path-part2>...'; after dropping two fields the parent reads verdict=SAFE, receipt=stale and the stage-4 prong1 becomes SAFE(stale) binding, which authorizes the delete.
confirmed_defects.fresh_ground_truth: souji-verify itself reports NOT-SAFE/none for the same path (its JSON output carries the TABs verbatim), and the --list path rejects the identical row as malformed (exit 2). Only the positional/engine-echo path was exploitable.
confirmed_defects.observed_baseline: exit 0; RESULT ... DELETED stale; source gone from tree and quarantine
confirmed_defects.contradicted_invariant: A target with no receipt must never be deleted; the engine's own verdict must not be reinterpretable by the caller's parser.

confirmed_defects.status: CONFIRMED: fresh /var/tmp repro; false DELETE after the ledger is rewritten during staging/hold
confirmed_defects.title: Quarantine never fingerprints the ledger at stage 1: an in-flight ledger rewrite authorizes the deletion of the sole copy
confirmed_defects.mechanism: second_check pins the ledger only around its own moved-to-obsidian prong (ledger_pin captured at line 334, compared at line 363). Stage 1 takes the receipt from the engine with no ledger pin at all, so a writer that replaces the ledger row during the hold window — repointing source_path at the original path and vault_path at the staged quarantine copy — satisfies every stage-4 prong (pin=ok mtime=ok source-sha=ok vault-sha=ok) and the copy is deleted.
confirmed_defects.fresh_ground_truth: The pre-attack ledger row pointed at an independent vault copy; after the attack the row pointed at the staged file itself. Both runs used a real writer thread polling for the staged path (no test hook), with --hold 2.
confirmed_defects.observed_baseline: exit 0; QVERDICT stage4-second PASS; RESULT DELETED; source gone from tree and quarantine
confirmed_defects.observed_candidate: exit 3; ABORTED; staged bytes retained (ledger=FAIL revoked-since-stage1)
confirmed_defects.contradicted_invariant: Authorization must be re-derived from the same authority that granted it; a ledger that changed between capture and delete cannot authorize the delete.

confirmed_defects.status: CONFIRMED: fresh /var/tmp repro; false SAFE in the engine (not propagated to a delete by quarantine)
confirmed_defects.title: verify accepts ledger rows that are not independent preservation records (self-copy, vault inside source, relative vault path, empty digest)
confirmed_defects.mechanism: try_obsidian only checks that vault_path exists and hashes to vault_sha256; it never rejects vault_path == source, vault_path inside a directory artifact, a relative (cwd-dependent) vault path, or a missing digest column. souji-vault-verify refuses all four (source-equals-vault, vault-inside-source, row-incomplete). Because quarantine's stage-1 authority is verify, the engine split is a live authorization risk: a row whose 'vault' is the artifact itself yields SAFE(moved-to-obsidian).
confirmed_defects.fresh_ground_truth: For the self-copy and inside-source fixtures the only surviving copy would have been the artifact itself; vault-verify's refusal is the correct verdict and was reproduced in the same fixtures.
confirmed_defects.observed_baseline: verify: exit 0, SAFE/moved-to-obsidian for all four row shapes; quarantine stage-4 happened to ABORT the self-copy and inside-source dir cases (bytes retained) but not the file self-copy (ABORTED) — no false DELETE reproduced from this class alone
confirmed_defects.observed_candidate: verify: NOT-SAFE with row-incomplete / source-equals-vault / vault-inside-source; quarantine refuses or aborts
confirmed_defects.contradicted_invariant: A preservation receipt requires an independent surviving copy; the artifact may not be its own vault, and a cwd-dependent path is not a receipt.

residual_risk: The stage-1 ledger pin closes the reproduced window (stage 1 -> delete) but is still a compare-at-check, not a lock: a writer coordinating with the final rm could in principle race the last re-read. Writer-coordinated generation/locking remains open, as S17 already disclosed.

The control-character rule is enforced in quarantine only. verify still emits records containing TABs in the path field; any other consumer that parses those records by position inherits the same ambiguity. Anchoring the parse (as the candidate does) is the general fix, not banning the byte.
